llmnav-catalog/1 repository=workduck catalog=workduck.workspace
Read semantic cards before opening source. Resolve current paths and signatures with llmnav query or show.

@workduck.workspace.path
role Validate workspace paths as readable absolute directories and return canonical display paths with closed error codes.
owns workspace path validation, directory readability check, path error mapping
excludes workspace registry storage, repository containment
invariant Only existing readable absolute directories produce a successful normalized workspace path.

@workduck.workspace.sync
role Serialize, encrypt, parse, decrypt, and normalize versioned workspace and project-registry synchronization envelopes.
owns workspace sync format, encrypted sync envelope, registry payload normalization
excludes Git synchronization, sync file transport
invariant Decrypted data is accepted only when envelope algorithms, versions, and normalized registry payloads match the closed sync contract.
